Task: Every 3 months OR 1500 operating hours: check pyrometer alignment & window cleanliness
Required_Parts: Pyrometer window / cleaning kit; IPA wipes / cleaning cloth
Preparation_Checklist: Confirm required parts availability (stock not mounted).
Safety_Protocol:
1) PPE minimum: safety glasses, work gloves, and closed shoes.
2) Confirm area is clear, stable, and communication with operator is active.
3) Heat hazard: verify cool-down or use heat-rated gloves/tools before touch.
4) Restart control: one assigned person approves restart after verification.
Procedure_Steps: Inspect pyrometer alignment and check window cleanliness; clean window if required.
Draw_Stop_Plan: Pause draw, isolate subsystem, perform checks, resume after verification.
Completion_Criteria: Task completed, system verified, safe restart confirmed.

Task: After every run: clean furnace entry disc (remove soot, wipe with IPA)
Safety_Protocol: Entry disc can be hot after a run; use heatproof gloves and allow cool-down.

Task: Monthly: inspect bottom doors for distortion/damage; replace if needed
Preparation_Checklist: [{"id":"prep-bottom-door-1","done":false,"text":"Confirm furnace bottom door set is at the line and not already mounted."},{"id":"prep-bottom-door-2","done":false,"text":"Lock area access, confirm cool-to-touch condition, and prepare insulated gloves + hand tools."},{"id":"prep-bottom-door-3","done":false,"text":"Stage waste bag, wiping cloth, and camera / note device for before-after condition check."}]
Safety_Protocol:
1) Confirm furnace has cooled enough for safe contact and isolate any hot-touch risk before removal.
2) Use gloves and eye protection while handling warped sheet and fasteners.
3) Keep one operator clear of the draw path while the second verifies door seating and closure.
4) Restart only after the door sits flush, latch points are secure, and no loose fragments remain.
